aasmano aur zameen mein jo bhi koi cheez hai , uss ney Allah ki tasbeeh ki hai , aur wohi hai jo iqtidar ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .
aey emaan walo ! tum aesi baat kiyon kehtay ho jo kertay nahi ho ?
Allah kay nazdeek yeh baat bari qabil-e-nafrat hai kay tum aesi baat kaho jo kero nahi .
haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss kay raastay mein iss tarah saff bana ker larrtay hain jaisay woh seesa pilai hoi imarat hon .

aur woh waqt yaad kero jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay :  aey meri qoam kay logo ! tum mujhay takleef kiyon phonchatay ho , halankay tum jantay ho kay mein tumharay paas Allah ka payghumber ban ker aaya hun-?    phir jab unhon ney tairrh raah ikhtiyar ki to Allah ney unn kay dilon ko tairrah kerdiya ,   aur Allah nafarman logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .

aur woh waqt yaad kero jab essa ban maryam ney kaha tha kay :  aey bano Israel ! mein tumharay paas Allah ka aisa payghumber ban ker aaya hun kay mujh say pehlay jo toraat ( nazil hoi ) thi , mein uss ki tasdeeq kernay wala hun , aur uss Rasool ki khushkhabri denay wala hun jo meray baad aaye ga , jiss ka naam Ahmed hai .    phir jab woh unn kay paas khuli khuli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to woh kehney lagay kay :  yeh to khula huwa jadoo hai .
aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah per jhoot baandhay , jabkay ussay Islam ki taraf bulaya jaraha ho-?   aur Allah aesay zalim logon  ko hidayat tak nahi phonchata .
yeh log chahtay hain kay apney mun say Allah kay noor ko bujha den , halankay Allah apney noor ki takmeel ker kay rahey ga , chahye kafiron ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
wohi to hai jiss ney apney Rasool ko hidayat aur sachai ka deen dey ker bheja hai takay woh ussay tamam doosray deeno per ghalib kerday ,   chahye mushrik logon  ko yeh baat kitni buri lagay .
aey emaan walo ! kiya mein tumhen aik aesi tijarat ka pata dun jo tumhen dardnak azab say nijat dila dey-?

. ( woh yeh hai kay ) tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool per emaan lao , aur apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kero . yeh tumharay liye behtareen baat hai , agar tum samjho .

iss kay nateejay mein Allah tumhari khatir tumharay gunahon ko bakhsh dey ga , aur tumhen unn baaghon mein dakhil keray ga jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi , aur aesay umda gharon mein basaye ga jo hamesha hamesha rehney wali jannaton mein waqay hon gay . yehi zabardast kamiyabi hai .

aur aik aur cheez tumhen dey ga jo tumhen pasand hai , ( aur woh hai ) Allah ki taraf say madad , aur aik aesi fatah jo unqareeb hasil hogi ! aur ( aey payghumber ! ) emaan walon ko ( iss baat ki ) khushkhabri suna do .

aey emaan walo ! tum Allah ( kay deen ) kay madadgaar ban jao , ussi tarah jaisay essa ban maryam ( aleh-assalam ) ney hawariyon   say kaha tha kay :  woh kon hain jo Allah kay wastay meray madadgaar banen-?  hawariyon ney kaha :  hum Allah kay ( deen kay ) madadgaar hain .  phir bani Israel ka aik giroh emaan ley aaya , aur aik giroh ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya . chunacheh jo log emaan laye thay , hum ney unn kay dushmanon kay khilaf unn ki madad ki , nateeja yeh huwa kay woh ghalib aaye .
